patch_description:
The best program (score 0.58) uses alternating RY parameters (ry_0/ry_1) that achieve strong generalization and robust worst-group margin (0.28). The current program underperforms (worst_group_margin 0.05) due to insufficient expressivity.

The recommendation is to insert a second alternating RY layer mid-circuit (after entanglers, before final RZ) using the same ry_a and ry_b parameters. This:
1. Adds expressivity without increasing distinct parameter count
2. Leverages proven heterogeneous RY alternation pattern
3. Should improve worst-group margin and robust separation
4. Maintains parameter economy (reuses existing ry_a, ry_b)

The insertion point is after the XX/YY entanglers, giving the circuit depth to develop more complex feature maps while keeping parameters minimal.
